name: Pietramala
description: This ambitious plant-based kitchen turns humble vegetables into refined, produce-driven plates that change with the seasons. It has become one of the most celebrated vegan dining rooms in Philadelphia and lands high on citywide best-of lists.

name: Cafe La Maude
description: A perpetually packed brunch destination that blends French technique with Lebanese flavors across an all-day menu. Weekend waits are common, driven by standouts like the ricotta pancakes and brisket huevos rancheros.

name: Apricot Stone
description: This intimate BYOB serves warm, spice-forward Armenian and Mediterranean cooking in a cozy setting well suited to date nights. Hummus plates, boreg, and char-grilled kebabs anchor the menu.

name: Anejo
description: A lively Mexican spot known for a wide-ranging taco lineup and a deep tequila and mezcal program. The bar stocks both familiar bottles and harder-to-find agave spirits.

name: Pera Turkish Cuisine
description: One of the few dedicated Turkish tables in the city, this BYOB leans confidently into bold Anatolian spices and sauces. The kebabs and grilled seafood are the dishes to build a meal around.

name: Heritage
description: Part restaurant and part live-music lounge, Heritage pairs an inventive New American menu with generous cocktails and a rotating roster of local performers. The atmosphere makes it as much a night out as a dinner.

name: Yanaga Kappo Izakaya
description: Chef Kevin Yanaga's izakaya delivers precise Japanese small plates alongside a hidden speakeasy-style omakase counter. The multi-course tasting is among the neighborhood's most sought-after seats.

name: Mana Modern Chinese
description: A newer arrival from restaurateur Tom Lau, Mana turns out polished modern Chinese cooking in a stylish room. Six varieties of soup dumplings share the menu with classics like kung pao chicken.

name: Terra Grill
description: Michelin-pedigree chef Laurent Tourondel's fire-driven steakhouse opened in 2026 with globally inspired plates spanning Italy, Asia, and the Mediterranean. Expect upscale surprises alongside prime cuts and wood-fired mains.

name: Silk City
description: A longtime neighborhood institution combining a classic diner with an attached bar and music venue. It serves comforting all-day fare from filet and eggs to burgers while doubling as a live-performance hangout.
